parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of decorated __init__ methods not being documented by Sphinx. It introduces a more robust approach to retrieving the class object, handling cases where the original approach fails.

issues.description: The patch introduces additional exception handling and import logic, which slightly increases the complexity of the code. However, this is necessary to handle the edge case of decorated methods.
